claims.claim: Prestine UK direct PS4 slim console in smooth working condition.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show the console model/brand/region text, and no power-on/boot or functional test is shown.

claims.claim: Comes with a pad (controller) extra pad is...
claims.evidence: Witness report clearly shows one PlayStation-style controller and a USB cable, but does not confirm number of controllers or any 'extra pad' beyond what is visible.

risks.risk: Console model/variant and region (PS4 Slim vs other PlayStation, UK region) may not match what the seller claims.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/model number (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and region/serial sticker, plus the box/receipt if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PlayStation-style console bundle with unknown model/region.

risks.risk: Not proven to be working (no boot/power test shown).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, successful boot to home screen, and at least one controller input working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: needs repair/untested).

risks.risk: Controller condition issues (stick drift, worn buttons, broken analogs) not shown.
risks.proof: Video clip of controller stick movement calibration test (or in-game movement) and button presses responding correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst case: may have drift or button faults).

risks.risk: Port damage or missing cables/accessories (HDMI/power adapter not confirmed included).
risks.proof: Photos showing all included items laid out (power adapter, HDMI cable, USB cable, any other accessories) and close-ups of each port for damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only, with cables/accessories not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Storage capacity (HDD/SSD size) and whether it’s included not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the storage info screen (System Settings > Storage) or a screenshot/video showing capacity.

risks.risk: Account/lock status (primary console/account lock, bans) not shown.
risks.proof: Video showing sign-in status and that it can reach settings without account lock; also show 'Deactivate as your primary PS4' status if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential account/lock risk (worst case: limited usability).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model/serial label (CUH model number) and any UK/region identifiers.
Short power-on/boot video to the home screen showing the controller working.
Video showing controller analog sticks and face buttons responding (no drift).
Lay out all included accessories on the table (power adapter, HDMI cable, any extra controller(s), headset, etc.) and confirm quantities.
Close-up photos of all ports (HDMI/USB/power) showing no bent/broken pins or damage.
Photo/screenshot of storage capacity from System Settings.
Video showing account/lock status (ability to access settings and sign-in/deactivate primary if relevant).
response.reason: The witness confirms a PlayStation-style console/controller appearance, but key pricing drivers (exact PS4 Slim model/region, working status, storage, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the report. Without a boot/working test and clear model/accessory details, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
